audience.title: Who are ozone baths for?
audience.lede: Ozone baths are recommended for increased fatigue, stress, swelling and reduced adaptive resources of the body, as well as during recovery periods after physical load.

cards.text: Ozone baths help to restore strength and energy.

how.title: How it works
how.lede: Five phases — from a gentle initial stimulus to deep recovery.

steps.title: Gentle oxidative stimulus
steps.text: Ozonated water creates a brief physiological stimulus for the skin and capillaries.

steps.title: Receptor and nervous system activation
steps.text: The peripheral nervous system and autonomic regulation engage.

steps.title: Eustress — beneficial stress
steps.text: The body receives a controlled signal toward adaptation, not toward defence or a panic response.

steps.title: Brief sympathetic activation
steps.text: A moderate release of catecholamines (hormones and neurotransmitters) supports clarity, tone and concentration.

steps.title: Recovery phase
steps.text: After activation, the body enters deep relaxation, restoration and a rebalancing of systems.
